{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the sentinel value -999.0 is used for missing data
print(df['biomarker_baseline'].value_counts().sort_index())

# Replace -999.0 with NaN to exclude it from mean computation
df_clean = df.copy()
df_clean['biomarker_baseline'] = df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Ensure the column is numeric
print(f'Column dtype: {df_clean["biomarker_baseline"].dtype}')

# Now compute the mean of the cleaned baseline biomarker values
mean_baseline_clean = df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
print(f'Cleaned mean baseline biomarker value: {mean_baseline_clean}')"}
